build.note: In-game capture; LMR27 recoil operands as in current data/weapons.json.

question: Does the recovery factor scale measured on the AK-205 (about 0.8) transfer to the LMR27, whose recovery profile has factor 13.7 and time exponent 0.56?

capture.loadout: 21.5" Factory barrel, FMJ, 20 Rnd, SF G2 5.00x, Standard then Lightened Suppressor
capture.conditions: standing ADS, about 27 m, FOV 103 (operator), 120 fps with audio, side-step and 2 s pause between pairs; ten pairs per band at 133, 233, 333/350 and 433 ms
capture.reencoded: Re-encoded 15 October 2026 (libx264 preset fast, CRF 24 for pair clips and CRF 18 for burst clips, audio copied) to cut file size about eight times; shot frames identical and pair separations within 1 px on the checked clips (verified 15 October: identical frame counts, identical shot counts from the ammo counter on every clip, template-fit pair separations within 1 px on the checked clips; burst clips at CRF 18 because CRF 24 lost the last digits of the final magazine). sha256Original is the hash of the capture as recorded.

sourceFacts.method: Same pipeline as L4040 (HUD-counter shot frames, blurred-maxima pair marks, lens scale from cluster spacings, predictions from the site law at the measured gaps), plus a two-Gaussian fit as a second estimator. See ANALYSIS.md.

control.description: Lens magnification 4.98 over 1x (AK-205 run: 5.00); every clip decodes as ten pairs; the lower mark of each pair sits on the reticle dot.

points: 233 ms band: Standard 0.384 +- 0.014 deg, Lightened 0.322 +- 0.018 (maxima; two-Gaussian 0.372 / 0.339) against stored-factor predictions 0.319 / 0.271 and x0.8 predictions 0.403 / 0.349. Effective factor scale 0.85 to 0.9.

133 ms band compromised: on this weapon shot 2 lands where the reticle top arc is drawn, and the arc mask cuts the star; measured range 0.50 to 0.75 deg, consistent with both predictions (0.598 / 0.649 Standard).
333 to 433 ms bands below the resolution floor of both estimators (about 25 px, 0.28 deg; the two-Gaussian fit returns 20 to 25 px for overlapping stars on the AK-205 400 ms band too).
Standard minus Lightened at 233 ms: 0.062 +- 0.023 (maxima) or 0.033 +- 0.017 (Gaussian) against 0.048 to 0.054 predicted: the x1.2 operand is consistent.
Method systematic: the two estimators differ by about 3 px at 25 px separations; the AK-205 short-band excess (0.06 to 0.08 deg) stands with that allowance.

inference: A single factor constant of about 0.8 to 0.9 fits the one clean LMR27 band and the AK-205 bands and bursts; the constant transfers across the two recovery profiles within one band's error. Whether it is exactly common needs a second clean LMR27 band at 180 to 200 ms.
unresolved: The 133 ms band (reticle arc), the bands beyond 300 ms (resolution floor), and the exact value of the constant on the slow profile.
siteImpact: Supports the L4040 proposal (recovery factor x0.8 on all weapons) as transferable across profiles; the LMR27 band alone would put the scale nearer 0.85.

leads.title: LMR27 pairs: the recovery factor scale transfers to the slow profile (about 0.85 to 0.9 at 233 ms); 133 ms band lost to the reticle arc, longer bands below resolution
leads.summary: At 233 ms the LMR27 pairs sit 0.05 to 0.065 deg above the stored-factor law and at the x0.8 law (effective scale 0.85 to 0.9, both suppressors), so the AK-205 constant transfers to the second recovery profile within one band; the x1.2 Lightened operand is consistent.
leads.reopenWhen: A second clean LMR27 band at 180 to 200 ms, or an estimator validated below 25 px separation.
